headline: vLLM outperforms on 24GB GPU but fails on large models
summary: Benchmarks show vLLM scaling 3.9x-5.4x on RTX 3090
details: vLLM outperformed llama.cpp and Ollama on a 24GB RTX 3090 GPU, scaling 3.9x-5.4x with concurrency. However, it failed outright on large models that spilled past 24GB.

The benchmark tested vLLM, llama.cpp, and Ollama across 5 models (1B to 116.8B params). vLLM's performance advantage came with a caveat: it ran out of memory on two large models, while llama.cpp and Ollama degraded to single-digit tok/s.

llama.cpp's manual layer offload tuning allowed it to beat Ollama's automatic split by 37x on time-to-first-token during RAM-spill. However, vLLM's failure to handle large models highlights its limitations.
